answer: Mechanism: an epoch-bound compute passport requires a non-transferable proof-of-work receipt. Four steps: (1) Registry issues a challenge salted by epoch and key. (2) Agent hashes to target, then submits its receipt. (3) Validators verify work and bind one quota slot to that key; rotating keys requires fresh work. (4) At expiry, the slot lapses. Each identity costs 2.5 kWh, about $0.45 at $0.18/kWh, and 90 minutes on a 40 W device. Copper wiring powers the meter; willow cannot multiply output, and each plume of identities needs another receipt. It is a numbered ticket per lap, not a new mask.
